articles.query: My Galaxy S24 battery drains really fast, it goes from 100 to 20 percent in a few hours

siis_response.title: Battery draining quickly on your Galaxy phone
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile Battery draining quickly on your Galaxy phone ( Smartphone,Others Mobile): # Troubleshooting Fast Battery Drain
Let's go through some steps to extend your battery life.
## Step 1: Turn On Power Saving
Go to Settings. Tap Battery. Tap the switch next to Power saving to turn it on.
## Step 2: Enable Adaptive Battery
Go to Settings. Tap Battery. Tap the switch next to Adaptive battery to enable it.
## Step 3: Put Unused Apps To Sleep
Go to Settings. Tap Battery. Tap Put unused apps to sleep.
## Step 4: Restart Your Device
Press and hold the Power button, then tap Restart. Tap Restart again to confirm.
## Step 5: Contact Samsung Support
If the battery still drains quickly after these steps, please contact Samsung Support to arrange for service.

articles.query: the camera app on my phone won't open, it just crashes back to the home screen

siis_response.title: Camera app closes or will not open on your Galaxy phone
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile Camera app closes or will not open on your Galaxy phone ( Smartphone,Others Mobile): # Troubleshooting Camera App Crashes
Let's go through some steps to get your camera working again.
## Step 1: Check Camera Access
Go to Settings. Tap Apps. Tap Camera access to confirm the app is allowed to use the camera.
## Step 2: Clear The Camera App Cache
Navigate to Settings. Tap Apps. Select Camera. Tap Storage. Tap Clear cache.
## Step 3: Restart Your Phone In Safe Mode
Press and hold the Power button, then touch and hold Power off, then tap Safe mode.
Check if the camera still crashes in Safe mode.
## Step 4: Update Your Software
Keeping your device's software updated regularly ensures the camera app continues to run smoothly.
## Step 5: Contact Samsung Support
If the issue persists after completing all the above steps, please contact Samsung Support to arrange for service.

articles.query: my phone got really slow and laggy after the last update, apps take forever to open

siis_response.title: Device running slow on your Galaxy phone
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile Device running slow on your Galaxy phone ( Smartphone,Others Mobile): # Troubleshooting Slow Performance
Let's go through some steps to speed your device back up.
## Step 1: Adjust Performance Profile
Go to Settings. Tap Battery and device care. Tap Performance profile.
## Step 2: Put Unused Apps To Sleep
Go to Settings. Tap Battery and device care. Tap the switch next to Put unused apps to sleep to enable it.
## Step 3: Restart Your Device
Press and hold the Power button, then tap Restart. Tap Restart again to confirm.
## Step 4: Perform A Factory Data Reset
Note: A factory data reset will erase all personal information from your device. Back up your data before proceeding.
Navigate to Settings, search for and select Factory data reset, and then tap Factory data reset again.
Review the information presented, then tap Reset, and then tap Delete all.
## Step 5: Contact Samsung Support
If the issue persists after completing all the above steps, please contact Samsung Support to arrange for service.
